# Pagination

> Page navigation for long lists and result sets.

This file matches the installed `pagination` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/pagination.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/pagination.md`.

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- `lucide-react@^1.78.0`

- `core`

- `@/components/control-ui/ui/pagination`: `Pagination`, `PaginationContent`, `PaginationItem`, `PaginationLink`, `PaginationPrevious`, `PaginationNext`, `PaginationEllipsis`, types `PaginationEllipsisProps`, `PaginationLinkProps`, `PaginationProps`, `PaginationContentProps`, `PaginationItemProps`

## Composition

### Page navigation

Links render anchors. Pass render to PaginationLink, PaginationPrevious, or PaginationNext to use your router's link component.

```tsx
<Pagination>
  <PaginationContent>
    previous page
      <PaginationItem>
        <PaginationPrevious />
      </PaginationItem>
    each page
      <PaginationItem>
        <PaginationLink />
      </PaginationItem>
    skipped pages
      <PaginationItem>
        <PaginationEllipsis />
      </PaginationItem>
    next page
      <PaginationItem>
        <PaginationNext />
      </PaginationItem>
  </PaginationContent>
</Pagination>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import type { ComponentProps, MouseEvent } from "react";
import { useState } from "react";

import {
  Pagination,
  PaginationContent,
  PaginationEllipsis,
  PaginationItem,
  PaginationLink,
  PaginationNext,
  PaginationPrevious,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/pagination";

const LAST_PAGE = 8;
const VISIBLE_PAGES = [1, 2, 3];

// Stands in for your router's link component, which PaginationLink renders through `render`.
function RouterLink({ href, children, ...props }: ComponentProps<"a">) {
  return (
    <a href={href} {...props}>
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

export function PrimitivePaginationExample() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(2);
  const go = (target: number) => (event: MouseEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setPage(Math.min(LAST_PAGE, Math.max(1, target)));
  };

  return (
    <Pagination>
      <PaginationContent>
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationPrevious href={`?page=${page - 1}`} disabled={page === 1} onClick={go(page - 1)} />
        </PaginationItem>
        {VISIBLE_PAGES.map((visiblePage) => (
          <PaginationItem key={visiblePage}>
            <PaginationLink render={<RouterLink />} href={`?page=${visiblePage}`} isActive={page === visiblePage} onClick={go(visiblePage)}>
              {visiblePage}
            </PaginationLink>
          </PaginationItem>
        ))}
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationEllipsis />
        </PaginationItem>
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationLink render={<RouterLink />} href={`?page=${LAST_PAGE}`} isActive={page === LAST_PAGE} onClick={go(LAST_PAGE)}>
            {LAST_PAGE}
          </PaginationLink>
        </PaginationItem>
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationNext href={`?page=${page + 1}`} disabled={page === LAST_PAGE} onClick={go(page + 1)} />
        </PaginationItem>
      </PaginationContent>
    </Pagination>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### pagination

- `--cui-pagination-link-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
- `--cui-pagination-link-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-pagination-link-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-pagination-link-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
